status: Proposal r3 for review. Copy /operatingIntent into the independently approved commissioning plan; the reviewer holds that copy outside the candidate tree.

decisions.openingOnlyDriveInhibit: The -3.5 deg limit inhibits drive output in the opening direction only; it never cuts the closing drive and never latches. Evidence: pan-stop-study-04 (a full cut fails 6 of 12 resets; the opening-only inhibit never trips in normal running). Idle mode coast.
decisions.gearboxProtection: Fit a mandatory slip clutch set between the worst normal-duty torque (15.4 N m) and the output-stage rating, or show a documented output capacity of at least 26 N m (F3 25.9 N m with the inhibit; pre-inhibit F1 peak 14.3 N m). r3 finds the capacity route valid only with a measured inhibit latency of about 1.5 ms or less, so the clutch is carried as required.
decisions.retentionFrom001: The owner delegated mechanical-viability decisions. Retaining the 001 pan contact surfaces, axis and drive beyond the floor profile named in commissioning.md:3 is accepted, on the 12-case simulations built on them and the failed fixed-path comparison (retained-from-001.md).

stopReplayInput.note: The study's lumped model (lever 100 mm, 6000 N m/rad, 15.8 N m s/rad) is unchanged. Only the series stiffness bound changes; if a native or bench value falls below 3000 N m/rad, replay.

drive.faultInterlock: Required in every mode: an absolute-encoder soft limit at -2 deg, plus an opening-direction drive inhibit at -3.5 deg on the pan controller's reverse-limit input, independent of the roboRIO. The inhibit zeroes opening output only, never cuts closing output and never latches. Idle mode coast. Trip-to-neutral <= 5 ms measured on the bench. The soft stop, its beam, the stow lug and the gearbox protection are sized for F2/F3 with the inhibit 5 ms late and for the bumper strike; inspect the pads after any fault event
drive.idleMode: COAST. Brake mode shorts the windings at the inhibit and raises the F3 gearbox torque to 41.5 N m (rotor inertia 3e-06 kg m2); coast is also the unpowered state the replay passes

outputStage.decision: Gearbox protection (owner decision): fit a mandatory 1/2 in hex friction slip clutch set between the worst normal-duty torque and the output-stage rating, OR show a documented output-stage capacity of at least 26 N m (F3 with an ideal inhibit). r3 records both routes and the latency condition on the second
outputStage.formula: (30 - 1.4) A x 0.00984 N m/A x 54.83 (the cap the controller can hold in any stall, including the feed peak)

clutchRoute.placement: between REV-41-1620 and the port drive hex; the gearbox plate stands off outboard by the clutch length with the six-hole pattern kept. Needs its own drive checked placement (open)
clutchRoute.basis: never slips at the 15.4 N m normal-duty cap; caps the gearbox at <= 18 N m in F1-F3 and B1 whatever the inhibit latency or rotor inertia

capacityRoute.validOnlyIf: measured inhibit trip-to-neutral latency <= 1.46 ms (F3 travel from -3.5 deg to the pad); at 5 ms the worst fault reaches 41.0 N m

outputStage.supplierRating: REV UltraPlanetary load ratings (docs.revrobotics.com/rev-crossover-products/ultraplanetary/load-ratings) as recorded in the FRC wiki, wiki/authored/frc/2025-poc/reference/reefscape-grip-slide-drive-sources.md:65: 40 N m output-stage FAILURE, reduced by shock and cantilever loads. A failure value, not a working rating
outputStage.verdict: The published 40 N m is a failure value. It is above the 26 N m ideal-inhibit demand but below the 41.0 N m late-inhibit demand, so the clutch route governs until the latency is measured. The roster carries the clutch as required
outputStage.currentCap: unchanged at 30 A (lowering it breaks the 29.62 A feed peak)
